hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that layers multi-tier fee mechanics (static, dynamic, and tiered) onto every swap, with built-in anti-sandwich protection inherited from AntiSandwichHook. Supports configurable fee distribution to LPs, treasury, and custom wallets, plus optional per-origin buy limits and allowlist-based access control during a configurable launch period.
